      主席報告
      CHAIRMAN'S STATEMENT



      華潤集團將繼續支持華潤置地「做實、做強、做大、做好、做長」


      China Resources Group will continuously support China Resources Land to Make it Solid, Make it
      Stronger, Make it Bigger, Make it Good, Make it Longer




      本人欣然向各位股東提呈本公司及本集團二零                     I am pleased to present the annual business review and outlook of the
      一九年十二月三十一日止之年度業務回顧與展                     Company and the Group for the year ended 31 December 2019 to the

      促進公司健康發展。                                performance targets in order to determine the bonus. To align the

      風險管理及內部監控                                 RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL

      董事會高度關注並全面負責維持本集團穩健有                      The Board highly values and has the overall responsibility for
      效的風險管理及內部監控系統，以保障本集團                      maintaining appropriate and effective risk management and internal
      財產及利益相關者之權益，並有責任檢討該系                      control systems to safeguard the Group’s assets and stakeholders’
      統之效率。為履行責任，董事會持續監督管理                      interests, as well as for reviewing the effectiveness of the systems.
      層對風險管理及內部監控系統的設計、實施及                      To fulfill its responsibility, the Board oversees management in the
      監察，透過成熟的組織架構、政策和程序的制                      design, implementation and monitoring of the risk management and
      訂、授權的界定基準等確保本公司維持風險管                      internal control systems to ensure the effectiveness of such systems
      理及內部監控系統的有效性。                             through well-established organizational structure, appropriate policies
                                                and procedures in place, as well as clearly defined lines of authority and
                                                responsibility.

      利。根據開曼群島法例第二十二章公司法（經修          premium and retained profits. Under the Companies Law (Revised)
      訂），在公司組織章程大綱及公司組織章程細則          Chapter 22 of the Cayman Islands, the share premium of the Company
      條文之規限下，如本公司在緊隨支付分派或股           is available for paying distributions or dividends to Shareholders
      息後，有能力於日常業務過程中如期償還其債           subject to the provisions of the Memorandum and Articles of
      務，則本公司之股份溢價可用作向股東支付分           Association of the Company and provided that immediately following
      派或股息。                          the distribution or dividend, the Company is able to pay its debts as

       付款的強制執行權（取決於銷售合約條款及合約適用法律的                                        日期的完成進度所用之估計並檢查所確認收入及成本之

       有關披露載於綜合財務報表附註5「主要會計判斷及估計」及                                   •   Reviewed the related disclosures in the consolidated
       附註6「分類資料」。                                                        financial statements.

       The properties have generally no alternative use due
       to contractual restrictions. However, to assess the
       enforceability of right to payment which depends on the
       terms of the sales contract and the interpretation of the
       laws applicable to the contract, a significant judgement
       is required. The Group has reviewed the terms of the
       contracts, the relevant local laws, the local regulators’
       view and obtained legal advice, to classify sales contracts
       into those with an enforceable right to payment and those
       without, and therefore apply different revenue recognition
       policy.

       For revenue from sales of properties recognised over
       time, the Group recognised revenue by measuring
       the progress towards satisfaction of the performance
       obligation at the reporting date, which was measured by
       the percentage of the contract costs incurred to the total
       estimated cost.

       Related disclosures are included in note 5 “Significant
       accounting judgements and estimates” and note 6
       “Segment information” to the consolidated financial
       statements.

         公平值為於計量當日在市場參與者之間於           Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or
         有序交易中出售資產所收取或轉讓負債所           paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market
         支付的價格，不管該價格是否可直接觀察           participants at the measurement date, regardless of whether that
         得到或使用另一估值技巧而估計。於估計           price is directly observable or estimated using another valuation
         資產或負債的公平值時，倘市場參與者於           technique. In estimating the fair value of an asset or a liability,
         計量當日為資產或負債定價時將會考慮的           the Group takes into account the characteristics of the asset or
         資產或負債的特點時，則本集團會考慮該           liability if market participants would take those characteristics into
         等特點。                         account when pricing the asset or liability at the measurement
                                      date.

 綜合基準                        BASIS OF CONSOLIDATION

 綜合財務報表包括本公司以及被本公司及          The consolidated financial statements incorporate the financial
 其附屬公司所控制實體的財務報表。本公          statements of the Company and entities controlled by the
 司在下列情況下即擁有控制權：              Company and its subsidiaries. Control is achieved when the
                             Company:

  •   可對被投資公司行使權力；           •   has power over the investee;

  •   就來自參與被投資公司的可變回報中       •   is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its
      承受風險或享有權利；及                involvement with the investee; and

  •   有能力使用其權力以影響其回報。        •   has the ability to use its power to affect its returns.

 倘事實及情況顯示以上所列三種控制情況          The Group reassesses whether or not it controls an investee if
 任何一種或以上出現變動，本集團會就其          facts and circumstances indicate that there are changes to one or
 是否取得被投資公司的控制權作重新評估。         more of the three elements of control listed above.

 本集團於取得附屬公司的控制權時開始將          Consolidation of a subsidiary begins when the Group obtains
 附屬公司綜合入賬，並於本集團失去附屬          control over the subsidiary and ceases when the Group loses
 公司的控制權時終止。尤其是，於年內收          control of the subsidiary. Specifically, income and expenses of a
 購或出售附屬公司的收入及開支，會由本          subsidiary acquired or disposed of during the year are included
 集團取得控制權當日起直至本集團失去附          in the consolidated income statement from the date the Group
 屬公司的控制權當日計入綜合收益表。           gains control until the date when the Group ceases to control the
                             subsidiary.

 本集團於合約開始時評估合約是否為或包       The Group assesses at contract inception whether a contract is, or

         金融資產減值                        IMPAIRMENT OF FINANCIAL ASSETS

         本集團就所有並非按公平值計入損益持有            The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit losses
         的債務工具確認預期信貸虧損（「預期信貸           (“ECLs”) for all debt instruments not held at fair value through
         虧損」）撥備。預期信貸虧損乃基於根據合           profit or loss. ECLs are based on the difference between the
         約到期的合約現金流量與本集團預期收取            contractual cash flows due in accordance with the contract and all
         並按原始實際利率的概約利率折現的所有            the cash flows that the Group expects to receive, discounted at an
         現金流量之間的差額釐定。預期現金流量            approximation of the original effective interest rate. The expected
         將包括出售所持抵押品或合約條款所包含            cash flows will include cash flows from the sale of collateral held
         的其他信貸升級措施所得的現金流量。             or other credit enhancements that are integral to the contractual
                                       terms.

         一般方法                          GENERAL APPROACH

         預期信貸虧損分兩個階段確認。就自初次            ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for which
         確認起未有大幅增加的信貸風險而言，預            there has not been a significant increase in credit risk since initial
         期信貸虧損就由未來12個月內可能發生違           recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses that result from
         約事件而導致的信貸虧損計提撥備（12個月          default events that are possible within the next 12 months (a
         預期信貸虧損）。就自初次確認起大幅增加           12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for which there has
         的信貸風險而言，不論發生違約時間，均            been a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition,
         須就於餘下風險年期內的預期信貸虧損計            a loss allowance is required for credit losses expected over the
         提虧損撥備（全期預期信貸虧損）。              remaining life of the exposure, irrespective of the timing of the
                                       default (a lifetime ECL).

         租賃－估計增量借款利率                            LEASES – ESTIMATING THE INCREMENTAL BORROWING RATE


         本集團無法輕易釐定租賃內所隱含的利                      The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit in a
         率，因此，使用增量借款利率（「增量借款                    lease, and therefore, it uses an incremental borrowing rate (“IBR”)
         利 率 」）計 量 租 賃 負 債 。 增 量 借 款 利 率 為      to measure lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of interest that
         本集團於類似經濟環境中為取得與使用權                     the Group would have to pay to borrow over a similar term, and
         資產價值相近之資產，而以類似抵押品與                     with a similar security, the funds necessary to obtain an asset
         類似期間借入所需資金應支付之利率。因                     of a similar value to the right-of-use asset in a similar economic
         此，增量借款利率反映了本集團「應支付」                    environment. The IBR therefore reflects what the Group “would
         的利率，當無可觀察的利率時（如就並無訂                    have to pay”, which requires estimation when no observable
         立融資交易之附屬公司而言）或當須對利率                    rates are available (such as for subsidiaries that do not enter into
         進行調整以反映租賃之條款及條件時，則                     financing transactions) or when it needs to be adjusted to reflect
         須作出利率估計。當可觀察輸入數據可用                     the terms and conditions of the lease. The Group estimates the
         時，本集團使用可觀察輸入數據（如市場利                    IBR using observable inputs (such as market interest rates) when
         率）估算增量借款利率並須作出若干實體特                    available and is required to make certain entity-specific estimates
         定的估計（如附屬公司的獨立信用評級）。                    (such as the subsidiary’s stand-alone credit rating).

         有。                            of the MPF Scheme are held separately from those of the group
